Steam Deck

Gameplay & Balance

Fixed an issue where the Burning effect of the Dual Shard of Wrathful Hatred did not work as intended.
Fixed an issue with the Phylactery reward. It now works as intended and matches its description.
Audio

Fixed an issue where Helmer's attack sounds would be playing twice.
Fixed duplicate audio playing for Modeus' secondary ability.
Fixed an issue with incorrect audio playing during Osric's death animation in battles within the Temple of Cinders.
Fixed an issue where audio was missing for the final blow of the Divine Thunder skill.
Environment & Character Movement
Fixed an issue in Skyless Grove where the player character could become visually hidden inside walls when moving close to certain surfaces.
Fixed an issue where the player character could clip through the Skyless Grove entrance in Elma'ar.
Fixed a clipping issue between Avyanna and the secret door on the first floor of the Tower of Jubilation.

UI & Controls

notes.title: Does Disciples: Domination feature different difficulty levels?

items.text: Yes, Disciples: Domination features 4 difficulty levels as well as 1 Custom difficulty level:
Story: For players who want to focus on the story and exploration. Enemies have less HP and deal less damage. Both healing at the end of turn and healing at the end of battle is increased.
Standard: For players who want a balanced experience. This is the default difficulty.

Hard: For advanced players who are familiar with tactical RPGs. Enemies deal more damage. Healing at the end of turn is removed and healing at the end of battle is reduced. Additional battle Events can appear.

Brutal: Be ready for an almost unfair experience, for the most determined of players. Enemies have even more Health and deal even more damage. Both healing at the end of turn and at the end of battle are removed. The chance of having additional events during battle is greatly increased.
Custom: For players who want a custom experience. All parameters are independently adjustable.
You may change the difficulty within the gameplay section of the settings screen.
